frontier.hypothesis: The residual is reachable only through a combine refusal whose C carrier is a CALL boundary (s17's R4 leg), which func_80017848 cannot supply without changing semantics - so if any lever remains it is not at the C-statement level but at the level of what GCC 2.7.2's cse does with the reg79/reg80 equivalence class at insn 89 (E-s16-2). Naming that canonicalisation rule would turn every loop-2 preheader spelling from a blind guess into a checkable predicate.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c canonicalises a register operand to qty_first_reg[reg_qty[regno]] (canon_reg); qty_first_reg can MOVE when a class member is invalidated (delete_reg_equiv / invalidate), and insert / merge_equiv_classes decides membership order. The candidate's tail `p = q;` and cell E2's tail `p = *(u8 **)(ctx + 0xC);` differ only in whether reg79 is re-set from a class member or from a MEM, and that single difference decides whether loop 1's copy survives combine.
frontier.next_probe: Add a BB2_CSE_DEBUG trace in canon_reg / insert / merge_equiv_classes / invalidate printing (insn uid, regno, reg_qty, qty_first_reg) for pseudos in the 72-120 range, rebuild ONLY tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 (never build/cc1), re-prove codegen identity with tmp/grind/func_80017848/s16/idump.sh, and diff the candidate's trace against cell E2's and cell X1's at insn 83 and insn 89. Note that even a confirmed predicate has no affordable C carrier (s17), so this is a naming exercise, not a lever.
